residency_notes: Novita's current public terms document the inference-content retention policy but do not identify a customer-selectable data or execution region for the managed API. Public GPU-region material should not be treated as a managed API residency guarantee.
prompt_training_notes: Novita's current terms adopt Zero Data Retention by default for user content: inputs and outputs are not retained beyond delivery or logged for human review, unless required by law or needed to provide services or technical support. Automated safety screening may still process content.
